summary: Allow @private top-level functions in goog.scope
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium']
stars: 0
commentCount: 7
Comment 0 (2013-10-08): What steps will reproduce the problem? 1. goog.scope(function() { /* @private */ function test() {} }); 2. The code above gives an error "The local variable test is in a goog.scope and is not an alias." What is the expected output? The code above should compile, and function test() be referenceable only from inside the file in question. If I replace "function test" with "var test = function", the code compiles.
Comment 2 (2013-10-09): Nick, let me know me if you don't have time to look at this (no hurry).
Comment 3 (2013-10-09): I'll take care of it. It's just a little bit tricky because of function hoisting.
Comment 4 (2013-10-14): https://codereview.appspot.com/14583044
Comment 5 (2013-10-24): This issue was closed by revision 13fb7fcbcad8.
Comment 6 (2013-11-15): This issue was closed by revision 13fb7fcbcad8.
